fuel_consumption.source_quote: Republic acquired Frontier Airlines from bankruptcy and Midwest Airlines in 2009; consolidated branded fuel operations include Midwest and Frontier: $144.9 million fuel expense. A one dollar change per barrel crude oil = $5.7M impact on fuel expense.

instrument_type_details.notes: Republic periodically purchases call options on crude oil for fuel hedging of branded operations (Frontier and Midwest Airlines, both acquired in 2009). Fixed-fee CPA operations remain unhedged (fuel pass-through). Fair value of fuel derivatives = $2.8M (asset) at December 31, 2009. Fuel hedges do not qualify for hedge accounting; MTM adjustments in fuel expense. Percentage of consumption hedged not disclosed.

warnings: Republic acquired Frontier Airlines out of bankruptcy (2009) and Midwest Airlines (2009), beginning fuel hedging for branded operations.
